title: Curate and production-import new Commons sound samples
description: Use the associated behavior story to discover direct members of these Commons categories only: Audio files of ambient music; Audio files of drum and bass; Audio files of sound effects; Audio files of drum patterns; Sounds of drums; Sounds of musical instruments; Synthesizer sound. Deduplicate against the existing Wikimedia Commons catalog by Commons page ID, fetch metadata in small batches, import only supported audio with complete credits and licensing, analyze files, stage only the requested new set, upload and register it in production, and save a review report for every excluded candidate. Verify every admitted recording and sample has complete attribution and a working production link.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Initial category research: the direct sound-effects and instrument-sound categories are the best sample-oriented additions; ambient and drum-and-bass add complementary electronic material. The production import must retain page-level licenses and source revisions, and video containers will be excluded.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Commons batch prepared 468 eligible new audio files from 7 direct-member categories with provenance snapshots and analysis; 99 exclusions are documented in the review report. Uploaded all 8,276 reviewed S3 objects (including 6 successful sequential retries); production Samples count increased from 536 to 1,004. App bucket import is continuing through Clip records, last observed at 8,813/18,430 with 0 failures; completion and final Samples/Clip/Marker linkage verification remain open.
